title: EDGAR Company Facts & Filings
description: Fetch SEC EDGAR submissions and/or XBRL company facts for one or more US companies. Provide tickers (AAPL), CIKs (320193), or name fragments (Apple).

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: List of tickers, CIKs (1–10 digits), or company name fragments to resolve via SEC company_tickers.json.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to return: filings only, XBRL facts only, or both.

formTypes.title: Form types
formTypes.description: Optional filter of SEC form types (e.g. 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K). Empty = all recent forms.

since.title: Since (filing date)
since.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Keep filings with filingDate on or after this date.

maxFilingsPerCompany.title: Max filings per company
maxFilingsPerCompany.description: Maximum filing rows to emit per resolved company (after filters).

metrics.title: Financial metrics (XBRL concepts)
metrics.description: us-gaap / dei concept names to keep (e.g. Assets, NetIncomeLoss). Empty uses a curated default set.

maxFactsPerMetric.title: Max facts per metric
maxFactsPerMetric.description: Most-recent fact values to keep per concept/unit.

includeTextExcerpt.title: Include text excerpt
includeTextExcerpt.description: If true, download each kept filing's primary document and emit a short plain-text excerpt row (extra SEC request + text-excerpt charge).

excerptMaxChars.title: Excerpt max characters
excerptMaxChars.description: Maximum characters for each text excerpt.
